name: EL7.AI
tagline: Financial market intelligence and research for your AI
description:
Financial market intelligence for your AI: markets news, economic calendar, 8 central banks, COT positioning, stocks, earnings, gold and oil, with sources and dates.

EL7.AI's hosted MCP server exposes 82 read-only tools across 15 areas of market research: real-time markets news and the EL7 Wire; the global economic calendar with history, consensus and surprise index; eight central banks (Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, BoC, RBA, RBNZ, SNB) with decisions, statement diffs, press-conference Q&A, previews and tone ranking; CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning; gold and oil fundamentals; stocks with scores, written analysis, screener, analyst consensus, earnings, insider and congressional trades; ETFs; market regime, seasonality and correlations; prediction markets; strategies; and a research library. English first, with full Arabic support.

Every answer returns the source date and an el7.ai link; missing dates are flagged as unverified. Tools read EL7's stored, published data and never place trades.

**Access:** requires an EL7 paid membership. Free accounts can call `el7_whoami` only; anonymous callers cannot access tools. Limits: 10,000 calls/month, 120/minute. Research information only, not personalised investment advice.

install.notes: Sign in with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration) when Cline prompts; no API key or local install needed. Alternatively, compatible clients can send a personal owner-scoped EL7 MCP API key as a Bearer token. Research tools require an EL7 paid membership. Docs: https://el7.ai/en/mcp?utm_source=cline&utm_medium=listing
